details:
tailwindcss-animate-bridge (2.0.8) is a Tailwind CSS plugin built from the template of the fake job interview campaign behind MAL-2026-17665 and MAL-2026-17666: the same Animate.css integration, published by the npm account coda517 (first version 2026-10-30 05:41 UTC). lib/catalog/source.js:5 requires the scoped package @utilitycraft/tailwindcss-motion-atelier, which is not readable on the public registry, and the plugin runs it when the Tailwind configuration loads. The published tarball has no install scripts and no network code: as in the earlier packages of this campaign, the working part is in the private dependency, which was not retrieved.

Found by Gatekeeper (https://github.com/lb2002/gatekeeper); read statically from the published archive, never executed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
